description: Trigger precision eval for asset-modification-wizard skill. Tests correct activation on bulk/batch asset modification queries, and correct rejection of single asset analysis, material analysis, and project audit queries.

cases.query: 모든 블루프린트에서 변경 - BP_Enemy_Goblin, BP_Enemy_Skeleton, BP_Enemy_Orc 같은 적 BP가 15개쯤 있는데, 전부 MaxHealth 변수를 현재값의 1.5배로 올려야 해. 하나씩 하면 너무 오래 걸리니까 일괄로 해줘
cases.reason: Bulk BP variable modification across 15 enemy assets with multiplier

cases.query: change MaxHealth in every - change MaxHealth from 100 to 200 in every Blueprint that inherits from BP_CharacterBase. there are about 20 of them across Content/Characters/ and Content/Enemies/. dry run first please
cases.reason: Batch Blueprint property change with inheritance filter, count, paths, and dry-run request

cases.query: PCG 그래프 8개에서 bulk change — PointsPerSquareMeter 파라미터를 일괄 수정해줘
cases.reason: Batch PCG parameter tuning across 8 graphs with specific node type and values

cases.query: change MaxHealth in every - add a TeamID int property (default value 0) to all Blueprints that inherit from ACharacter in the project. should be EditAnywhere and BlueprintReadWrite. probably about 12 BPs
cases.reason: Batch property addition to character-inheriting BPs with specifiers and count estimate

cases.query: 일괄 수정 필요해. BP_Enemy_* 패턴 BP들의 MovementSpeed 변수를 전부 500으로 바꾸고, bCanFly 변수는 false로 통일. 근데 BP_Enemy_Dragon만 bCanFly=true로 예외 처리해야 해
cases.reason: Bulk modification with wildcard pattern, multiple variables, and specific exception

cases.query: 밸런스 패치로 BP 대량 변경해야 하는데, BP_Weapon_Sword, BP_Weapon_Axe, BP_Weapon_Spear 등 근접 무기 BP 8개의 BaseDamage를 현재값에서 20% 감소시키고 AttackSpeed는 10% 증가시켜야 해
cases.reason: Balance patch bulk change with percentage-based adjustments on multiple variables

cases.query: 모든 블루프린트에서 MaxHealth 디폴트값을 100에서 150으로 바꿔야 하는데, ACharacter 상속 BP만 대상이야. AItem이나 AWeapon 상속 BP는 건드리면 안 됨
cases.reason: Filtered batch modification — only ACharacter children, exclude other inheritance chains

cases.query: batch update collision settings on all StaticMeshActors in L_Village level. change collision preset from NoCollision to BlockAll, and enable GenerateOverlapEvents. there are around 200 props
cases.reason: Batch collision config change on 200 actors with specific preset and overlap setting

cases.query: 모든 적 BP에 FactionTag라는 GameplayTag 프로퍼티 추가해줘. 기본값은 Faction.Enemy로. BP_Enemy_로 시작하는 것만 대상이고, BP_EnemySpawner 같은 건 제외해야 해
cases.reason: Batch GameplayTag property addition with prefix filter and exclusion pattern

cases.query: 일괄로 모든 무기 BP의 BaseDamage를 2배로 올려줘. BP_Weapon_Rifle, BP_Weapon_Shotgun, BP_Weapon_SMG 등 총 10개. 변경 전에 현재값 리스트 먼저 보여주고 확인 받고 적용해줘
cases.reason: Bulk damage doubling with preview-before-apply safety workflow
